title: Research Stack
description: A curated research toolkit, organized by workflow and discipline. Starred repositories and suggested essentials can belong to several folders.

folders.label: Research Stack
folders.description: Reusable research tools, libraries, datasets, skills, and references across disciplines.

folders.label: General research
folders.description: The shared workflow from finding sources to presenting reproducible work.

folders.label: Read papers & manage sources
folders.description: Discover, read, translate, annotate, organize, and cite research sources.

folders.label: Code & analyze data
folders.description: Prepare data, use notebooks, compute statistics, and build research analyses.

folders.label: Run experiments & reproduce results
folders.description: Design, track, optimize, version, evaluate, and reproduce experiments.

folders.label: Write, visualize & present
folders.description: Write papers, build figures and diagrams, and share research through slides.

folders.label: AI & machine learning
folders.description: Methods and reusable tooling for machine learning research.

folders.label: Statistics & classical ML
folders.description: Statistical modeling, inference, causal methods, and classical machine learning.

folders.label: Deep learning & training
folders.description: Neural network frameworks, optimization, and training systems.

folders.label: Computer vision
folders.description: Image and video understanding, visual representations, and generative vision.

folders.label: Natural language processing
folders.description: Text processing, language models, and language-centered research workflows.

folders.label: Transformers & architectures
folders.description: Transformer implementations, architectural ideas, and model adaptation.

folders.label: Datasets & evaluation
folders.description: Research datasets, benchmarks, model evaluation, and data quality tooling.

folders.label: Time series & forecasting
folders.description: Forecasting libraries, temporal models, and time-series research references.

folders.label: Reinforcement learning
folders.description: Reinforcement learning algorithms, environments, training, and evaluation.

folders.label: Finance, econometrics & quant
folders.description: Data, methods, and research infrastructure for quantitative finance and economics.

folders.label: Market data & financial research
folders.description: Obtain financial data and investigate markets, securities, and economics.

folders.label: Econometrics
folders.description: Estimate economic relationships with statistical and causal models.

folders.label: Portfolio construction & risk
folders.description: Study portfolio allocation, optimization, factor exposure, and risk.

folders.label: Backtesting & trading
folders.description: Implement and assess systematic trading ideas with reusable tooling.

folders.label: Financial machine learning
folders.description: Apply machine learning and forecasting methods to financial problems.
